verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Bugbot analyzes every PR for bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues. It leaves inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes, and the docs page confirms it identifies bugs and security issues together. However, the security claim is a single generic line, and community praise covers bug-finding in general rather than security findings. Missing for 10: documented coverage of specific classes like injection risks, leaked secrets and insecure patterns; details on security detection depth or accuracy; independent or hands-on corroboration of security findings.
